QUOTE: "**3. Detached worker: `ExternalBridge::run_async_ask`** ... `.detach()` at line 1222) runs `entropic_run` on a detached thread" and "it is detached. `ExternalBridge::stop()` ... does not wait for in-flight async tasks."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies run_async_ask as the one detached worker (as opposed to joined threads) and explains it outlives its caller/stop() with no join or tracking.
